effects.description: Damages the recipient by a percentage of their MAX HP, once per tick, for the duration of the debuff. The number of ticks per second increases with Skill Speed. This debuff can be stacked.

bio: Sodama and her twin brothers were born to sacred duty, but only she took their birthright seriously. Her brothers set out in search of power and glory, so she set out in search of her brothers. Sodama arrived too late to stop their corruption … so she brought home their heads to serve instead.
